guarantee.sentence: per-point conformal tail-bet: p = (1+rank)/(n+1) is super-uniform under exchangeability of held-out and live scores (distribution-free); under THIS construction's self-fit median/MAD held-out calibration the exchangeability is O(1/n)-approximate and mildly anti-conservative, NOT exact -- see regime.exchangeability_note, which this sentence previously contradicted; e = 0.1*p^(-0.9) satisfies E[e|H0] <= 1 by the calibrator integral identity

quantifiers.text: under O(1/n)-approximate exchangeability (self-fit reference), any score distribution
quantifiers.proof_artifact: conformal super-uniformity (exact for a FIXED reference) + integral of kappa*p^(kappa-1) = 1; unit test asserts both. The self-fit O(1/n) gap (K4.1.10) is carried in regime.exchangeability_note and is NOT proved away here

regime.exchangeability_note: O(1/n)-approximate, anti-conservative, under this construction's self-fit held-out calibration (K4.1.10) -- not the exact identity the DESIGN PAGE (methodology/coverage-gap-detectors) still states; that disagreement is still filed for wiki write-back. MEASURED at coverage Amendment v2.C47.1 (probe: validation/coverage/tools/self-fit-exchangeability.mjs): against an out-of-fold reference fitted on a disjoint split, whose exchangeability is EXACT, the self-fit excess on the healthy per-point exceedance is ~1.1e-6 on an exceedance level of ~2.7e-3 at the registered n = 10,000 -- pooled-median estimator 1.095594e-6 +/- 4.68e-9 across three PRNGs, agreeing to 1.4% with the closed form 2*phi(T)/(2*n*phi(0)) = 1.110875e-6 (T = 3.0000074, the exceedance boundary). That is 0.00227% of the distance from this card's measured lower_95 = 0.0017464 to the alpha = 0.05 bar, so the registered outcome (a) fired with a 4,404x margin: the gap is NEGLIGIBLE at this n, it is now quantified, and NO out-of-fold restructure is registered. The anti-conservative DIRECTION is confirmed by measurement at z = +234, which it previously was not. The rate is O(1/n), MEASURED and not merely derived: n*excess is 0.0098/0.0110/0.0113 at n = 2,500/10,000/40,000 -- flat across a 16-fold range -- with constant 4.06. These figures SUPERSEDE the wider 2.6e-6 to 4.5e-6 range this note carried at the previous freeze, which came from an under-replicated probe whose headline a defective generator-agreement rule promoted over its own more precise reading; corrected at the correcting append to v2.C47.1's results append, where the original stands. The MAD half of the self-fit is INERT: countGte compares |a_i-m|/mad against |x-m|/mad with mad>0 enforced, so p is invariant to mad and only the MEDIAN's self-fit matters -- K4.1.10's 'median/MAD pulled slightly toward itself' is corrected to 'a MEDIAN' at C47.1.1. NOT bounded by this measurement, named: the single-calibration-draw realization effect, which is far larger and points the other way (this card's registered run read exceedance 0.001855 against the exchangeable ideal 27/10001 = 0.00269973, -31%, conservative) and which no precision on 1.1e-6 touches. The module docstring's own 'exact' claim was corrected at coverage Amendment v2.C1 C1.9 and no longer overstates it, so this note no longer cites it.
